ns2:section.sectionText: Course analyzes U.S.-Cuba Relations in terms of the goals of each side and dynamics of their interactions. Emphasis placed on what brought about policy of each side, its consequences, role of the military, economic force, danger of war and role of change. Cuban revolution, U.S. attempts to stifle it and Cuban Missile Crisis are evaluated. Course includes: visit to Cuba (January 5-17), briefings from government and party officials and a significant on-campus portion. Course requires application and approval to study abroad. Course includes meetings during the Fall 2015 term and travel during the Winter break. Grades not submitted until January, 2016.
